payload.answer: Use poneytail to suggest an ablation/freeze

options.description: No new records, tests or fixes for these parts; they stay in the tree behind one README line and are retired when they next break. The intent loop and the merge check stop counting their drift.
options.label: Freeze them (Recommended)

options.description: Delete these parts and their tests and records in this work (about 3,000 to 6,000 lines). The hosts adapters go too unless you name one you use.
options.label: Remove them now

options.description: They stay first-class; their drift and records keep counting.
options.label: Keep building them

payload.question: Several parts of plumb show no evidence of use in its logs: the browser workspace, the Obsidian view, the pi-agent-factory importer, the benchmark, the read-only MCP server, and the Codex, Pi and Hermes adapters (no message has ever come from those hosts). Each carries records, tests and drift that slow every turn. What happens to them? (Name under Other any you do use.)
